items.why: Stocks are rebounding after the tech sell-off (CNBC) and geopolitical risk eased after Trump's vow of no Iran strikes before the midterms (WSJ), so the fear gauge is unwinding.
Part of the broad megacap rebound; Amazon helped push the Dow up Friday morning (MarketWatch), with AWS AI growth as the lingering bullish theme.
Riding the broad tech rebound after the sell-off (CNBC), with megacap growth names higher across the board (Reuters) and recent analyst support behind it.
Musk asserted control over the Terafab chip project (Barron's) and Tigress reiterated a Buy rating with a $550 target ahead of Oct 21 earnings.

market_note: S&P futures up 0.44% and Dow futures up 0.62%, with indexes on track for weekly gains (Reuters).
summary: Stocks are higher at midday Friday as tech shares rebound after the sell-off, with the VIX falling below 15. Pressure eased further after Trump said he will not strike Iran before the midterms.
